name: Commando Plus
description: TEST BUILD: untested in game. Commando missions made a little more forgiving, each option in commando-plus.ini: no mission timer, free Resupply calls at the drop-in (0 to 2), extra uses of the Super Destroyer call-in, more stims and grenades in point-of-interest caches, and outpost caches: every enemy base cleared pays out free resupply calls (the game's reward ammo rack). every_mission 1 applies them to every mission. Host or solo.
